::: {#def-compute-bound}

#### Compute-bound

Training is **compute-bound** when how long we are willing to train limits the model's performance,
rather than the amount of data or anything else [@godbole2023playbook].
Then training longer,
with the [hyperparameters](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/model-selection.html#sec-hyperparameters) tuned for the longer run,
improves the validation performance.

:::
